query.text:
select a.unit_id, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, y.ten_kh as ten_kh, b.dia_chi_lh, isnull(c.ten_tt, '') as ten_tt, a.ma_tt, d.ten_nvbh, isnull(e.phone, '') as dien_thoai, f.ten_bp, a.dien_giai, cast(a.status as char(1)) as status , replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct),2),' ','0') day, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct),2),' ','0') month, cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) year, a.ngay_ct , z.ten_kh as ten_nha_may, z.dia_chi_lh as dc_nha_may, rtrim(a.ma_kh3) + ' - ' + x.ten_kh as dd_giao_hang, rtrim(a.ma_kh4) + ' - ' + y.ten_kh as ben_ban_hang , a.ma_kh2, z.ong_ba as nguoi_lh, a.ma_kh4, d.ma_bp, isnull(e.phone, '') + case when isnull(e.phone, '') = '' then '' else ' / ' end + isnull(e.e_mail, '') as dt_mail_lh
from m91 a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtt c on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt left join dmnvbh d on a.ma_nvbh = d.ma_nvbh left join sysuserinfo e on a.ma_nvbh = e.username left join dmbp f on d.ma_bp = f.ma_bp left join dmkh z on a.ma_kh2 = z.ma_kh left join dmkh x on a.ma_kh3 = x.ma_kh left join dmkh y on a.ma_kh4 = y.ma_kh
where a.id = @id
select line as stt, a.ma_vt, b.ten_vt, a.ngay_dong_hang, a.ngay_kh_gh, a.so_luong, isnull(c.ten_dc, '') as ten_dc, isnull(d.so_po, '') as so_po, b.ma_so, b.nguyen_lieu, b.mau_sac, rtrim(b.ma_mau) + '/' + RTRIM(cast(b.tl_mau as float)) as ma_mau_tl, rtrim(b.ma_pg) + '/' + rtrim(cast(b.tl_pg as float)) as ma_pg_tl, e.ten_qcdg from d91 a with(nolock) left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmdc c on a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc and c.ma_kh in (select ma_kh from m91 where id = @id) left join m64 d on a.id_po = d.id left join dmqcdg e on a.ma_qcdg = e.ma_qcdg where a.id = @id
select cast(null as image) as logo, rtrim(ma_kh2) + '_Logo.png' as file_name from m91 where id = @id
